results.name: Standing Neck Mobility Circumductions
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back
Circumduct the head both clockwise and anti-clockwise making sure you are working on the end range throughout the movement.

results.name: Standing Neck Extensions
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Lean your head back trying to keep the front of the neck straight.
Point your chin to the ceiling.

results.name: Standing Neck Flexions
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Tuck your chin in and drop your head forwards without rounding the back.

results.name: Standing Neck Rotations
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Rotate your head from side to side without rounding your shoulders.

results.name: Standing Neck Side Flexions
steps: Pull your shoulders back and away from the ears and straighten the back.
Lean your head to the side (bring your ear to your shoulder) without shrugging your shoulder or leaning the spine to the side.

results.name: Seated Radial Nerve Slider
steps: From the seated position bring your arm out to the side with the palm facing back.
Flex your wrist at the same time you are leaning your head towards your outstretched arm.
Bend your head away from the the outstretched arm while simultaneously extending the wrist.

results.name: Seated Radial Nerve Tensioner
steps: Bend your elbow bringing your thumb to the centre of your chest.
Extend your elbow to the side with the palm facing back, and wrist flexed
As your extending the arm, lean your head towards the opposite shoulder
Once you reach maximum tension (without pain) hold the position

results.name: Alphabet
steps: Sit on a box or bench
Keep one foot off the ground by pulling onto your knee, or by crossing one leg over the opposite knee.
Try to form the letters of the Alphabet with your foot.

results.name: Big Toe Abduction
steps: Sit on a bench with your bare foot on the ground.
Slightly raise your big toe before trying to move it towards the opposite side (abduction).
Expect he range of motion is very limited and the movement to be very difficult.
It helps a lot having your toe on a line as benchmark.

results.name: Big Toe Dorsiflexion
steps: Sit on a bench with your bare foot on the ground.
Raise your big toe as far as it can go, without moving the rest of the toes.

results.name: Standing Doming
steps: From the standing position press the big toe into the ground till you feel the inside part of your foot raise off the ground
The arch of your foot should now look more pronounced.
Do not roll your foot out to lift the inside part of your foot.

results.name: Seated Doming
steps: Sit on a bench or box. Press the big toe into the ground till you feel the inside part of your foot raise off the ground
The arch of your foot should now look more pronounced. Do not roll your foot out to lift the inside part of your foot
You should perform the exercise bare foot or with socks, but do not wear shoes.

results.name: Eversions
steps: Sit on a step or low box, preferably with a back support. Extend both legs and wrap the band around the balls of the working foot
Pass the band around the other foot as shown in the video. Hold the end of the band with the opposite arm of the working foot
The ankle should be at 90° and turned inwards (inversion) before you start the movement. Turn the ankle out, without moving the rest of the leg.

results.name: Standing Inversions Hold
steps: Stand up straight with a relatively narrow stance.
Roll your feet out and balance.
Make sure you do not roll out excessively or you are risking re-injury.

results.name: Band Seated Inversions
steps: Sit on a step or low box, preferably with a back support. Extend both legs and cross the working leg over the non working leg.
Wrap the band around the balls of the working foot. Pass the band around the other foot as shown in the video.
Hold the end of the band with the same arm as the working foot. The ankle should be at 90° and turned outwards (eversion) before you start the movement
Turn the ankle in, without moving the rest of the leg.

results.name: Single Leg Balance 2
steps: Stand upright with a braced core.
Choose the supporting leg and shift your weight on that, while lifting the other slightly off the ground.
Try to maintain your balance while bouncing a tennis ball off the wall or ground.

results.name: Single Leg Bosu Ball Balance 2
steps: Place the supporting leg on the middle of a bosu ball.
Keep the knee of the suspended leg slightly bent.
Try to maintain your balance on the bosu ball while bouncing a tennis ball off the wall.

results.name: Machine Hip Adduction
steps: Sit in the machine with your legs apart, pads against your outer thighs. Adjust the seat and pad position comfortably.
Slowly squeeze your legs together, focusing on using your inner thigh muscles. Pause when the pads are close together.
Slowly return to the starting position, maintaining control. Avoid letting the weights slam. Repeat for desired reps and sets.

results.name: Machine Hip And Glute Adduction
steps: Stand on the platform and set the pad just over the hip of the working leg.
Place the working leg over the pad.
Press your leg inward. Aim to get the longest range of motion possible.

results.name: Bodyweight Butterfly Stretch
steps: Sit on your butt with your knees bent and feet touching each other.
Grab your feet and lean forward until you feel a stretch in your groin.

results.name: Scapular Elevation
steps: From the standing or seated position straighten your back.
Pull the shoulders back but keep them relaxed.
Move shoulders towards from your ears and return to the starting, relaxed position.

results.name: Machine Horizontal Leg Press Calf Raise
steps: Adjust the machine in accordance with your height.
The balls of your feet should be supporting your weight on the bottom of the platform, your heels extending off of it.
Extend your heels upwards while keeping your knees stationary, and pause at the contracted position.
Slowly return to the starting position. Repeat.

results.name: Machine Horizontal Leg Press Calf Jump
steps: Start with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Shift your weight onto the balls of your feet and raise stay flat footed. Using your calf muscles, mimic a jumping motion but don't leave the platform.
Explode onto your toes and hold for a second.

results.name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Bilateral On Box
steps: Stand on the edge of a box, knees extended.
Let your weight push your heels towards the ground.
You should feel your calves being stretched.

results.name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Push Up Position
steps: Get yourself in the pushup position.
Straighten your knees and try to push one heel down towards the ground.
Cross your other leg over the top to apply extra pressure to the stretch.

results.name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Unilateral On Box
steps: Stand on the edge of a box, knees extended.
Bend one leg while allowing the weight to push the heel of your straight leg towards the ground.
You should feel your calves being stretched.

results.name: Gastrocnemius Stretch Unilateral On Wall
steps: Stand by a wall but not too close.
Place the palms on the wall and extend one leg behind you, while slightly bending the front leg.
Push the wall in order to drive the heel of the extended leg into the ground till you feel a stretch in your calf.

results.name: Dumbbell Seated Tibialis Raise
steps: Sit on a box or bench, place your heels on a step or plate, and place dumbbells on your quads.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.

results.name: Seated Tibialis Raise
steps: Sit on a box or bench, place your heels on a step or plate.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.

results.name: Standing Tibialis Raise
steps: Step on the plate, and place barbell on your back.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.
Try holding at the top for a few seconds then bring your toes back down to the floor.

results.name: Dumbbell Standing Tibialis Raise
steps: Place your heels on a step or plate, and hold dumbbells to your side.
Raise your toes straight toward the ceiling.
Hold at the top for extra benefit. Slowly return to the starting position.

results.name: Dorsal Flexion Hold
steps: From the standing position, raise your toes and balance on your heels for the given duration.
Maintain a good upper body form.

results.name: Wall Supported Dorsal Flexion
steps: Lean against a wall, raise your toes and balance on your heels for the given duration.
Maintain a good upper body form.

results.name: Kettlebell Tibialis Raise
steps: Sit on a bench with a kettlebell draped over your mid-foot.
Let the kettlebell pull your foot downward.
Raise your foot straight up and squeeze the front shin.

results.name: Machine Goblet Sissy Squat
steps: Place the sissy squat pad just behind the knees and the front pad all the way up against your ankles.
Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Sit straight back into a squat. Then push your calves into the back of the pad and extend your knees back to the original position.

results.name: Machine Sissy Squat
steps: Place the sissy squat pad just behind the knees and the front pad all the way up against your ankles.
Hold a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Sit straight back into a squat. Then push your calves into the back of the pad and extend your knees back to the original position.

results.name: Bodyweight Reverse Step Up
steps: Start with a box or bench behind you and one of your feet on the box/bench.
The balls of your feet should be planted on the box/bench.
Drive through the ball of your foot extending your knees until you're upright and standing on the box.

results.name: Seated Hip Flexion Hold
steps: Sit on a bench without back support.
Keep an upright back and your shoulders back.
Raise one leg and maintain the position for the specified duration.

results.name: Standing Mini-Band Hip Flexion
steps: Wrap a loop band around your feet.
Drive a knee upwards till your thigh is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment and then return to the starting position.
Try to maintain balance and a good posture when raising the knee.

results.name: Band Straight Leg Hip Flexions
steps: Attach a band to a fixed point.
Wrap the loose end of the band around your ankle.
Face away from the attachment point.
Raise your working leg against the resistance.

results.name: Hip Flexor Stretch Kneeling Lunge 1
steps: Bring yourself to kneeling lunge position. Keep a 90° angle at knees.
Slide the front knee forward while gently leaning back.
Squeeze the glute on the side of the leg that's to the front to avoid lower back complaints.

results.name: Hip Flexor Stretch Kneeling Lunge 2
steps: Bring yourself to kneeling lunge position. Keep a 90° angle at knees.
Slide the front knee forward while gently leaning back. Raise your arm diagonally backwards
Squeeze the glute on the side of the leg that's to the front to avoid lower back complaints.

results.name: Hip Flexor Stretch Kneeling Lunge 3
steps: Bring yourself to kneeling lunge position. Keep a 90° angle at knees.
Back foot should be elevated (the higher the elevation the more the hip flexor/upper quad will stretch).
Slide the front knee forward while gently leaning back.
Squeeze the glute on the side of the leg that's to the front to avoid lower back complaints.

results.name: Infinity Loop Standing Hip Mobility
steps: From the standing position raise one knee till the thigh is parallel to the ground.
Bring the knee to your side without rotating the hips.
The knee drives the movement and the ankle lags slightly behind.

results.name: Standing Knee Raise Hold
steps: Stand up straight and with a good posture.
Shift your weight onto the supporting leg while driving the other knee.
Your thigh should be parallel to the ground.

results.name: Floor Incline Leg Raise
steps: Sit on the floor and lean back into your palms or on your elbows.
Raise a straight leg a few centimeters off the ground and hold the position for the specified duration.

results.name: Mini Band Laying Hip Flexion
steps: Loop band around feet, lie flat on back.
Lift one leg upward, keeping knee straight.
Lower slowly and alternate sides under control.

results.name: Mini Band Single Leg Raise
steps: Loop band around ankles, stand tall holding support.
Lift one leg forward with straight knee.
Lower slowly and repeat before switching sides.

results.name: Mini Band Standing Hip Flexion
steps: Loop band around feet or anchor behind you.
Lift one knee upward to hip height.
Lower slowly without leaning backward.

results.name: Calf Raise 3A Soleus Bias Bilateral
steps: From the standing position, bend your knees till you get to a squated or semi-squated position
Maintain the squat while raising both heels off the ground
Hold the position for a split second before lowering your heels again
Do not rest at the bottom. As soon as you feel your heels touch the ground, repeat the movement

results.name: Calf Raise 3B Soleus Bias Unilateral
steps: From the standing position, bend your knees till you get to a squated or semi-squated position. Be close to a pole or squat rack to use for balance
Maintain the squat while shifting your weight onto the working leg and raising the other off the ground
Raise your heel off the ground
Hold the position for a split second before lowering your heel again
Do not rest at the bottom. As soon as you feel your heel touch the ground, repeat the movement

results.name: Soleus Stretch
steps: Stand close to a wall on a narrow, staggered stance (toes of the back leg should be at the same level as the heel of the front leg).
Keep your weight on the back leg as you bend your knees.
Hold the position for the prescribed duration.

results.name: Curtsy Lunge
steps: Step your left foot diagonally behind your right leg, crossing it behind your body. Bend your knees and lower your hips until your left thigh is parallel to the floor and your right knee is hovering just above the ground.
Push through your right foot to straighten your legs and return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your other leg.

results.name: Dumbbell Goblet Curtsy Lunge
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell in a goblet position.
Step your left foot behind and to the right of your right foot, crossing it behind your right leg.
Bend your knees and lower your hips down and back, as if you were about to sit in a chair.
Push through your right heel to straighten your right leg and return to the starting position.

results.name: Medicine Ball Thruster
steps: Hold medicine ball at chest with elbows tucked and feet shoulder-width.
Squat down until thighs are parallel, keeping chest tall.
Drive upward and press ball overhead in one smooth motion.

results.name: Barbell Wrist Extension
steps: Grab a barbell with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

results.name: Dumbbell Bench Wrist Extension
steps: Grab two dumbbells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

results.name: Kettlebell Bench Wrist Extension
steps: Grab two kettlebells with an overhand grip and lay your forearms across a bench.
Let your wrists flex fully, then extend your wrists.

results.name: Seated Wrist Flexor Stretch
steps: Bring one arm in front of you palm facing up, elbow straight and shoulder relaxed.
With your other hand hold onto the palm and force it into passive extension.
This will stretch your wrist flexors.

results.name: Cable Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Bar Curl
steps: Use a bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
steps: Use a rope attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Use a neutral grip thumb facing up pinky-facing down). Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Seated Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Sit on a bench facing away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Hammer Bayesian Curl
steps: Stand facing away from the cables and grab two handle attachments.
Take a neutral grip, flex your elbows, and extend.

results.name: Cable Seated Bayesian Hammer Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine and sit on the bench. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Use a neutral grip thumb facing up pinky-facing down). Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Hand Plank
steps: Start in a kneeling position with your hands planted on the ground.
Pick your knees up off the ground. Hold in this position with a flat back.

results.name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie on your back.
Bend knees, hands behind head.
Twist torso, touch elbow to opposite knee. Repeat.

results.name: Long Lever Forearm Plank
steps: Start in a hand plank position and walk your elbows further out until your ears are between your biceps.
Hold in this position for the allotted amount of time.
Make sure you keep a flat back for the whole set.

results.name: Reverse Crunch
steps: Sit in a v position.
Pull legs and torso together.
Extend back into the starting position.

results.name: Rower Knee Tuck
steps: Place your feet on the rower seat and get in to a hand plank position.
Pull your knees to your chest and flex your abs.

results.name: Bench Lift Off Active
steps: While seated on a bench, place your palms on the bench by your sides
Palm placement should allow room for the fingers to grip the edge of the bench
Try to lift your bodyweight off the bench by pushing the palms into the bench
Lockout your elbows and repeat or hold isometrically

results.name: Bench Lift Off Static
steps: While seated on a bench, place your palms on the bench by your sides
Palm placement should allow room for the fingers to grip the edge of the bench
Try to lift your bodyweight off the bench by pushing the palms into the bench
Lockout your elbows and hold isometrically

results.name: Leg Lowers
steps: Lie on your back. Raise your legs but bend your knees
Keep a 90° angle at hips and knees. Lower your toes to the ground without bending your knees
Make sure you maintain a flat lower back against the ground throughout the movement.

results.name: Cable Incline Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set fairly low.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Incline Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set fairly low.
Bring the handle across your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulder and elbow simultaneously.

results.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to cable with handle set low, palm rotated inward before lifting.
Bring arm upward and across chest in an arc, keeping elbow slightly bent.
Squeeze upper chest at the top, then return slowly while maintaining internal rotation.

results.name: Kettlebell Push Press
steps: Start with kettlebell in rack position.
Dip at knees and hips.
Explosively push kettlebell overhead, fully extending arms.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set to shoulder height.
Bring the handle to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulder and elbow simultaneously.

results.name: Landmine Alternating Single Arm Press
steps: Stand facing the landmine leaning forward slightly with the end of the barbell held in one hand at your shoulder with your elbow positioned beneath your wrist.

While keeping your elbow pointed forward, drive the bar directly overhead, switching hands at the top of the movement. Lower the bar back down to the other side of your body, mirroring the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps, switching hands at the top of each rep.

results.name: Landmine Kneeling Alternating Overhead Press
steps: Start in a kneeling position facing the barbell with one hand holding the end of the barbell at your shoulder with your elbow tucked beneath your wrist.
Keeping your elbow pointing forward, drive the barbell up overhead until your arm is fully extended and switch the bar to your other hand at the top of the movement.
Control the descent of the bar to your other shoulder and repeat movement for desired reps, switching hands at the top of each rep.

results.name: Kettlebell Clean And Press
steps: Start with kettlebells between legs.
Swing kettlebells up to shoulder.
Press kettlebells overhead.

results.name: Vitruvian Arnold Press
steps: Stand tall with your palms facing yourself.
As you press, rotate your arms.

results.name: Vitruvian Overhead Press
steps: Hold the handle attachments with your fists to the sky and elbows toward the floor.
Press the handles to the ceiling.

results.name: Core Stability 1 Crosslateral Limb Raise 4Pt Position
steps: Bring yourself to the 4 point position (on all fours)
90° angles at hips and shoulder and neutral spine
Raise opposite limbs till they are parallel to the ground
Hold for a split second and bring back to starting position

results.name: Core Stability 2 Opposite Shoulder Tap 4Pt Position
steps: Bring yourself to the 4 point position (on all fours). 90° angles at hips and shoulder and neutral spine.
Lift your knees slightly off the ground supporting your weight on palms and toes.
Maintain a toe placement roughly at shoulder width (the wider the leg stance the easier the exercise - the narrower the stance the more difficult it becomes.
Tap your opposite shoulder with your fingertips.

results.name: Core Stability 4 Crosslateral Limb Raise Push Up Position
steps: Bring yourself to a strict push-up position
Maintain a toe placement roughly at shoulder width (the wider the leg stance the easier the exercise - the narrower the stance the more difficult it becomes.
Tap your opposite shoulder with your fingertips.
Do not tilt or shift your hips. Do not round or arch your back.

results.name: Core Stability 5 Crosslateral Limb Raise Into Knee Elbow Tuck Push Up Position
steps: Bring yourself to a strict push-up position
Raise opposite limbs till they are parallel to the ground
Hold for a split second and then try to bring your elbow to your opposite knee by driving both towards the centre of the body.
Spine might curve slightly but you should not shift your hips during the movement.

results.name: Kettlebell Seated Overhead Press
steps: There should be a straight line from your elbow to fist (vertical forearms).
Sit tall and try not to arch your spine as you're pressing.
Press until your elbows are extended and push your head forward slightly.

results.name: Landmine Half Kneeling Single Arm Overhead Press
steps: Start facing the landmine on one knee with your other foot in front of you while holding the barbell in one hand at your shoulder on the same side as the knee that is on the ground.
Drive the bar upwards while keeping your elbow pointed forward until your arm holding the bar is fully extending, then control the bar as your lower it back to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps, then switch sides.

results.name: Landmine Kneeling Overhead Press
steps: Start kneeling in front of the landmine, facing towards it, with your knees hip-width apart and your back straight while holding the end of the bar in both hands in front of your chest.

Push the landmine up overhead by fully extending your arms until the weight is directly over your head. Pause briefly at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the landmine back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of reps.

results.name: Landmine Lateral Raise
steps: Stand perpendicularly to the barbell, holding the end of the bar at your outer hip with your inner hand and your palm facing your body.
While keeping your core braced and your arm straight, lift the barbell diagonally up and towards the direction of the landmine attachment, then return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for desired number of reps before switching sides.

results.name: Machine Assisted Parallel Bar Dips
steps: Grip bars with arms straight, shoulders above hands. Place knees on pad.
Lower slowly until elbows are at 90 degrees.
Push back up to start position, extending arms fully.

results.name: Cable Bench Chest Fly
steps: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cables just below shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

results.name: Cable Decline Bench Chest Fly
steps: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cables above shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

results.name: Cable Braced Single Arm Chest Press
steps: Stand sideways to cable, hinge forward, and grab something for stability.
Press across the body going just short of extending your elbow.

results.name: Cable Braced Single Arm Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to cable, hinge forward, and hold handle at shoulder height with an internally rotated shoulder.
Brace free hand against support, then bring working arm across chest in an arc.
Squeeze chest at the end, then slowly return to starting position.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Decline Bench Chest Fly
steps: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cable above shoulder height.
Bring the handle to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbow stays in a fixed position.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Bench Chest Fly
steps: Bring a bench over to the cables, set the cable just below shoulder height.
Bring the handle to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Press the weight forward. From there, your shoulder should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbow stays in a fixed position.

results.name: Cable Braced Single Arm Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to cable, hinge forward, and hold handle at shoulder height.
Brace free hand against support, then bring working arm across chest in an arc.
Squeeze chest at the end, then slowly return to starting position.

results.name: Seated Median Nerve Slider
steps: Abduct your arm at 90°, elbow straight and palm facing up.
Bend your elbow and wrist, bringing the fist close to the shoulder, while leaning the head to the opposite side.
Alternate between these positions to mobilise the median nerve.

results.name: Seated Median Nerve Tensioner
steps: Abduct your arm at 90°, elbow straight and palm facing up.
Extend your wrist (point the fingers downwards).
Tilt the head to the opposite side making sure you do not bend the elbow.
Find the position of maximum tension (without pain) and hold.

results.name: Seated Ulnar Nerve Slider
steps: Abduct your arm at 90° palm facing down.
Bend your elbow and wrist bringing your front of your fingertips to your temple while leaning the head towards the the arm.
Lean the head away from the arm as you extend the elbow and flex the wrist.
Alternate between positions to mobilise the ulnar nerve.

results.name: Seated Ulnar Nerve Tensioner
steps: Abduct your arm at 90° palm facing down.
Bend your elbow and wrist to bring the palm to face the ceiling while leaning the head towards the opposite shoulder.
Find the position of maximum tension (without pain) and hold.
To increase the stretch, press the palm against the face and try to point the elbow up.

results.name: Bosu Ball Single Leg Balance
steps: Place the supporting leg on the middle of a bosu ball.
Keep the knee of the suspended leg slightly bent.
Try to maintain your balance on the bosu ball.

results.name: Rotator Cuff External Rotations 1
steps: Stand side ways to a pulley (you can also attach a theraband to a fixed point instead).
Hold the grip (or band) with the arm away from the pulley. Bring that arm by your side and bend it at 90°
Externally rotate the palm against the resistance. Your elbow should remain by your ribs throughout the movement

results.name: Rotator Cuff External Rotations 2
steps: Stand on one end of a theraband with one foot and hold the loose end with your opposite hand.
Bring your elbow forward by 45° (at shouder) but maintain a 90° angle at elbow
Externally rotate against the resistance.

results.name: Rotator Cuff External Rotations 3
steps: Abduct your arm at 90° (raise your arm to the side).
Keep a 90° angle at elbow, forearm parallel to the ground.
Externally rotate against resistance.

results.name: Rotator Cuff Mobilisation Lacrosse Ball
steps: Lie on the floor and place a massage ball under your rotator cuff.
Support your elbow with your opposite arm.
Roll into the ball to increase pressure and away from it to reduce.

results.name: Seated Shoulder Abduction
steps: Stand or sit with your arm by your side, palm facing forward.
Reach your hand out to the side and over your head without bending the elbow
The thumb leads the movement.

results.name: Dumbbell Service Exercise
steps: Stand up straight and hold a dumbbell in one arm. Perform a bicep curl across your body
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder and rotate palm and elbow out.
Point the elbow towards the ceiling while the dumbbell remains just over the shoulder.
Extend your elbow to raise the dumbbell over your head. Start lowering your arm to your side as you turn the palm to face down

results.name: Side Lying External Rotator Cuff Stretch
steps: Lie on your side with the under arm outstretched in front of you.
Pull your shoulder back to stabilise the scapula.
Bend your elbow at 90° or more.
Use your top arm to press the palm of the under arm out.

results.name: Standing Shoulder Abduction
steps: Stand up straight holding a dowel. The stretching arms palm should face forward
Push the dowel to the side with the opposite arm.
This in turn will raise the stretching arm over the head.

results.name: Shoulder Abduction Stretch
steps: Stand sideways to a wall.
Raise the arm that is on the side of the wall and place the blade of the palm against the wall.
Slide your arm up over your head and step in towards the wall to increase the stretch.

results.name: Pushup Position Shoulder Clock
steps: Wrap a loop band around your wrists and get yourself in a pushup position.
Support your body on one arm, while the other moves out taping the hour positions of the clock.
If you're moving your right arm it should be taping 12, 1, ..., 6.
If you're moving your left arm it should be taping 12, 11, ..., 6.

results.name: Band Shoulder Y Raise
steps: Hold one end of a band with your arm to the side and behind your body.
Hold the other end in front of your body (overhand grip).
Move your arm away from your body and upward while externally rotating your shoulder.
Finish with your arm over your head and thumb up

results.name: Shoulder External Internal Rotation
steps: Externally and internally rotate the shoulder to mobilise the joint on the specific movement.

results.name: Shoulder External Rotation Deceleration
steps: Lie on a bench facing down.
Bring your arm parallel to the ground and bent at the elbow, while holding a weighted ball.
Externally rotate your shoulder letting go of the ball.
Grab the ball before it falls to the ground.

results.name: Dumbbell Pullover Eccentrics
steps: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell over your shoulder, straight arm.
Slowly lower your arm towards the ground (overhead position).
Pause in the stretched position.
Bend your elbow to return to the starting position.

results.name: Standing Shoulder Flexion Mobility
steps: From the standing position grab the dowel with one arm, thumb on top, in front of the centre of your body.
Grab the dowel with your other arm to the side and behind your body.
The arm that is back, guides the other in front of you and into the overhead position.

results.name: Shoulder Flexion Wall Stretch
steps: Stand facing a wall.
Raise your arm above the head and place it on the wall, thumb facing back.
Slide the arm up and lean into the wall to increase the stretch.

results.name: Kettlebell Shoulder Flexion Bent Elbow Hold
steps: Stand up straight with the working arm in front of you and bent at the elbow (90°).
Hold an inverted kettlebell in that arm.
The goal is to maintain the position of the kettlebell without it falling over.

results.name: Kettlebell Walking Shoulder Flexion Bent Elbow Hold
steps: Stand up straight with the working arm in front of you and bent at the elbow (90°).
Hold an inverted kettlebell in that arm. Walk around holding the kettlebell in that position.
The goal is to maintain the position of the kettlebell without it falling over.

results.name: Kettlebell Kneel To Stand Shoulder Flexion Bent Elbow Hold
steps: Stand up straight with the working arm in front of you and bent at the elbow (90°).
Hold an inverted kettlebell in that arm.
Try to kneel and then stand up without allowing the kettlebell to fall over.

results.name: Shoulder Girdle Stability Circles
steps: Stand facing a wall. Pin a gym ball between your palm and the wall (elbow straight).
Push your arm into the ball without leaning into it.
While applying pressure, form the sign of the cross (up/down/left/right) and circles.

results.name: Side Shoulder Girdle Stability Circles
steps: Stand sideways to a wall. Pin a gym ball between your palm and the wall (elbow straight).
Push your arm into the ball without leaning into it.
While applying pressure, form the sign of the cross (up/down/left/right) and circles.

results.name: Serratus Activation Plank
steps: Support your weight on your forearms and toes (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.

results.name: Bosu Serratus Activation Plank
steps: Support your weight with your forearms on the bosu and toes on the floor (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.

results.name: Bosu Serratus Activation Active Plank
steps: Support your weight on your forearms and toes (plank).
Allow your upper back to sink in between the shoulder blades.
Push your elbows into the ground and slightly forward, and move the shoulder blades away from the spine.

results.name: Serratus Activation Cross Punch
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell over your shoulder with a straight arm.
Form the sign of the cross adding a protraction (punch) on every end of the cross, including the middle position.

results.name: Shoulder Flexion Thoracic Extensions
steps: Place a tube roller or half tube on the ground parallel to your body.
Lie on the tube making sure your whole back and neck are supported.
Knees bent and on the ground, lower back flat on the tube and chin tucked in.
Bring your arms by you hips and pull shoulders back.
This is your starting position. Raise arms and drop them back towards the ground over your head

results.name: Thoracic Flexion And Extensions
steps: Bring yourself on all 4's. Push the ground away from you, rounding back and shoulders as much as possible.
To enhance the spine flexion suck the belly button in and tuck the tailbone (coccyx) under. Hold this position for a brief moment
Now do the exact opposite, try to bend the spine backwards. Go back and forth on these positions

results.name: Wall Angels
steps: Stand against a wall with your back flat, arms at 90° by your sides.
Slowly raise arms overhead, keeping elbows and wrists in contact with the wall.
Lower arms back down to starting position, maintaining constant wall contact throughout.

results.name: Ankle Circle
steps: Sit or stand, lift one foot slightly off the ground.
Rotate your ankle in a circular motion.
Complete the allotted amount of reps, then switch directions and repeat on the other foot.
